### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of one smrnaseq run (multiqc/, mirna_quant/, the miRDeep2 result_*.csv tables, pipeline_info/) |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV or CSV): sample id in the first column (or a column named sample), one column per factor. Enables the design filters, colouring and the group comparison defaults. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design table sample-id column (links join on it). Auto-detected as the first column; defaults to 'sample'. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design column the dashboards group and colour by. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. |
| `GENOME` | — | UCSC assembly name the novel precursor coordinates are linked out to (the genome the run mapped to). |
| `SKIP_MIRDEEP` | — | Set (--var SKIP_MIRDEEP=true) for a run with --skip_mirdeep: no result_*.csv tables, so the miRDeep2 collections are pruned. |
| `SKIP_MULTIQC` | — | Set (--var SKIP_MULTIQC=true) for a run with --skip_multiqc: no report, so the MultiQC and miRTrace collections are pruned. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`, `ANNOTATION_COLS`

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`mirdeep2/novel_precursors.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mirdeep2/novel_precursors.py) | Novel miRNA precursors merged across samples, one row per locus. | `precursor_id`, `chromosome`, `start`, `end`, `strand`, `samples_detected`, `detection_pct`, `calls`, `max_score`, `median_score`, `max_true_positive_pct`, `total_reads`, `mature_reads`, `star_reads`, `loop_reads`, `star_support`, `randfold_pct`, `rfam_alert`, `seed_match`, `best_sample`, `mature_sequence`, `star_sequence`, `precursor_sequence`, `precursor_length`, `genome_position` |
| [`mirdeep2/predictions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mirdeep2/predictions.py) | miRNA precursor predictions from miRDeep2 result tables, one row per candidate. | `prediction_id`, `sample`, `category`, `candidate_id`, `score`, `true_positive_pct`, `true_positive_sd`, `rfam_alert`, `total_reads`, `mature_reads`, `loop_reads`, `star_reads`, `randfold_significant`, `mirbase_mirna`, `seed_match`, `mature_sequence`, `star_sequence`, `precursor_sequence`, `precursor_length`, `chromosome`, `start`, `end`, `strand`, `locus` |
| [`mirdeep2/score_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mirdeep2/score_summary.py) | The miRDeep2 score-cutoff summary, one row per sample and cutoff. | `sample`, `score_cutoff`, `novel_reported`, `novel_false_positives`, `novel_true_positives`, `known_in_species`, `known_in_data`, `known_detected`, `known_detected_pct`, `signal_to_noise` |
| [`mirtop/isomir_composition.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mirtop/isomir_composition.py) | isomiR composition of each sample, in four exclusive partitions. | `sample`, `rank`, `taxon`, `abundance`, `percent` |
